description: This PHP source file defines the class 'FormatWithWorkStation' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Maintenance\AccessStrategy\FormatValue'. The class implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface and provides functionality to retrieve and format the name of a subunit entity based on an ID, utilizing traits for accessing company structure services. It is part of a plugin for the OrangeHRM system related to maintenance access strategies for formatting values related to workstations.

classes.name: FormatWithWorkStation
classes.description: Implements value formatting for workstation entities by retrieving subunit names based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the name of the subunit associated with the given entity value ID, or null if not found.
